conviction_note: MPS is the target of Intesa Sanpaolo's live exchange offer (1.60 ISP shares + EUR 1.25 cash per MPS share). Since the 2026-10-03 raise its daily returns track ISP with beta 0.996, correlation 0.975 and a residual sd of 0.45% over 22 sessions, and it trades about 1% ABOVE the offer value (11.564 vs an implied 11.45 on 2026-11-05 intraday). So the 6 Nov move is mostly Intesa's move and the Q3 print reaches only the small residual. abs_move_pct 1.6 is the mean absolute day of a 2%-sd stock in this offer regime. p_up 51 because the only MPS-specific lean (a likely solid quarter: Barclays sees the sharpest NII growth among Italian banks, and the last two prints beat consensus) acts on the 0.45% residual and cannot outweigh the offer currency. Findings sum to +0.15 and the scaled number is +0.03; both are near zero for the same reason.

MPS's pattern is board in the evening and release at about 07:41 CET the next morning: Q1 2026 was disseminated '12 Maggio 2026 07:41:15' after the board 'conclusosi ieri sera' (https://www.emarketstorage.it/sites/default/files/comunicati/2026-05/20260512_183833.pdf), and H1 2026 was disseminated '7 Agosto 2026 07:41:43' after the 6 Aug board (https://www.emarketstorage.it/sites/default/files/comunicati/2026-08/20260807_188084.pdf). Expected release: 6 Nov about 07:40 CET, before the open. Even if it comes out after the close on 5 Nov, the window close(11-05) -> close(11-06) is the same
positioning_check: CONSOB posizioni nette corte, as of 2026-11-04: no disclosed net short at or above 0.5% (register read, short_ratio 0.0, change 0.0; https://www.consob.it/documents/11973/395154/PncPubbl.xlsx/fbefe0a2-795b-bad3-9369-beccbeb14f27). In a share-exchange offer, arbitrage shorts sit in the offeror (ISP), not the target, so this register says little here

findings.finding: MPS is priced as Intesa's offer currency, not on its own earnings. Since the 2026-10-03 raise to 1.60 ISP + EUR 1.25, its daily returns regress on ISP.MI with beta 0.996, correlation 0.975 and residual sd 0.45% (22 sessions to 2026-11-05). On 2026-11-05 intraday it sits at 11.564 against an offer value of 11.45 (ISP 6.375), a 1.0% premium that has held between -0.4% and -1.8% since 10-12. So the Q3 print can move only that residual.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: no MPS print has fallen inside this offer regime; the baseline's six estimated reactions (median 2.96%) are all pre-offer standalone prints and do not describe how the stock trades now
findings.original_quote: Intesa Sanpaolo proseguirà l'OPAS su tutte le azioni ordinarie MPS, con componente in contanti elevata a 1,25 euro (websim, 2026-10-30, paraphrased by fetch; offer terms also on https://forbes.it/2026/10/05/intesa-rilancio-opas-mps-delfin-assemblea-29-ottobre)
findings.why_not_priced: Not a mispricing claim. It is a sizing fact: the tape is already priced off the offer, which is why the finding is sized at zero. If the market were trading MPS on its own earnings, the BMPS/ISP residual would be several times 0.45%
findings.independence: Eurex corporate-action notice treats BMPS as a takeover target (https://www.eurex.com/ex-de/rules-regs-de/kapitalmassnahmen/kapitalmassnahme-informationen/Banca-Monte-dei-Paschi-SpA-Share-Takeover-updated-on-06-October-2026-5334478)

baseline_tension: The baseline lean (-0.32, from the run-up alone) and the +6.05% 5-day run-up both reflect ISP's rally into and after its own results (ISP +6.5% from 10-30 to 11-05), not anything MPS-specific. Neither the findings nor the lean say anything about Intesa's next session, which decides the window.
language_note: the Italian primary filings (eMarket STORAGE) gave the release timestamps (07:41 CET the morning after the board) that settle the session; no English source carried them

the 29 Oct EGM outcome details (the BPM/BG offers declared lapsed, Intesa waiving the merger condition, the antitrust timing and 'Assolutamente no' on a raise) came from Italian wires (Teleborsa, Websim). English results gave only the offer terms

lessons_applied: nothing changed. 'In a live bid, results are noise' (Capricorn) confirms the draft, which already treated the offer as the finding. 'Too small about the move' was weighed and not applied: abs_move_pct rests on a measured one-day scale for this name inside the offer regime (sd 2.0%, residual to ISP 0.45%), not on uncertainty about the sign
